## ✨ Added
- First stable release of Matrix All-in-One for Unraid: a single Docker image (`ghcr.io/junkerderprovinz/matrix:latest`) that bundles everything needed to run a Matrix homeserver on Unraid.
- **Synapse** - Matrix homeserver, built on the official Element image; security patches arrive as soon as upstream ships.
- **coturn** - TURN/STUN server for voice and video calls.
- **Element Web** - modern Matrix client at `/element/`.
- **Synapse-Admin** - admin UI at `/admin/`.
- **lighttpd** - serves the static UIs and `/.well-known/matrix/*`.
- **Plug-and-play** - only `SERVER_NAME` + Postgres credentials required; all configs are auto-generated and self-healing on every boot.
- **Auto-admin** - set `ADMIN_USER` + `ADMIN_PASSWORD` on first boot and the container creates the admin and logs it in to Element + Synapse-Admin automatically.
- **Federation toggle** - a single env var (`ENABLE_FEDERATION`) flips between the public Matrix network and a private island.
- **Single proxy host** - federation works behind one NPM proxy host with two custom locations, no second proxy needed.
- **Hourly auto-rebuild** - GitHub Actions checks for new Synapse releases every hour and rebuilds for `linux/amd64` + `linux/arm64`.
- **Idempotent init** - every boot validates and repairs `homeserver.yaml`, log config, and absolute paths.
- Install: fetch the template in the Unraid terminal, then add the container via **Docker → Add Container → Template "Matrix"**:
```bash
curl -fsSL -o /boot/config/plugins/dockerMan/templates-user/my-Matrix.xml \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/junkerderprovinz/matrix/main/unraid-template.xml
```
Full step-by-step guide (Postgres, NPM, federation, first user) is in the [README](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/matrix#readme).
- Required prerequisites: a PostgreSQL database with `ENCODING 'UTF8' LC_COLLATE='C' LC_CTYPE='C' TEMPLATE template0`; a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager) with `client_max_body_size 100M;` and `proxy_read_timeout 600s;` in the Advanced tab; and a public domain pointing at your Unraid IP.
License: Apache 2.0
